crossRefs.note: “Can a man be profitable to God? Surely he who is wise is profitable to himself.
Is it any pleasure to the Almighty that you are righteous? Or does it benefit him that you make your ways perfect?
If you are righteous, what do you give him? Or what does he receive from your hand?
For you meet him with the blessings of goodness. You set a crown of fine gold on his head.
“Or who has first given to him, and it will be repaid to him again?”
Now therefore, if you will indeed obey my voice, and keep my covenant, then you shall be my own possession from among…
Behold, to Yahweh your God belongs heaven, the heaven of heavens, and the earth, with all that is therein.
Yours, Yahweh, is the greatness, the power, the glory, the victory, and the majesty! For all that is in the heavens and…
The earth is Yahweh’s, with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell in it.
If I were hungry, I would not tell you, for the world is mine, and all that is in it.
The heavens are Yahweh’s heavens, but he has given the earth to the children of men.
for “the earth is the Lord’s, and its fullness.”

translations.web: Who has first given to me, that I should repay him? Everything under the heavens is mine.
translations.bsb: Who has given to Me that I should repay him? Everything under heaven is Mine.
translations.kjv: Who hath prevented me, that I should repay him? whatsoever is under the whole heaven
translations.asv: Who hath first given unto me, that I should repay him? Whatsoever is under the whole heaven is mine.
